claims.excerpt: De POA-refunddienst werd na twaalf weken publiek gelanceerd.
claims.claim: The POA-refund service launched publicly after twelve weeks.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: We passed alpha and beta Service Standard assessments and launched to the public in only 12 weeks.
claims.narrative: Het POA-refundteam lanceerde de dienst na twaalf weken
claims.explanation: The timing and public launch match the source.

claims.excerpt: binnen de aanvankelijk gevraagde paar weken
claims.claim: The initially requested delivery period was a few weeks.
claims.label: F1 minor immaterial imprecision
claims.evidence: We were initially asked to deliver the service in a matter of weeks
claims.narrative: binnen de aanvankelijk gevraagde termijn van enkele weken
claims.explanation: “A matter of weeks” does not specify a couple or a precise number, while “paar weken” can suggest a small specific number. The narrative’s “enkele weken” is closer.
claims.materiality: The exact duration is unspecified, but this does not materially change the point that the requested deadline was very short.

claims.excerpt: werd niet haalbaar geacht als de gebruikersdienst kwalitatief moest blijven.
claims.claim: Delivery within the requested period was judged infeasible if the team was to provide a quality user service.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: which put huge pressure on everyone and we quickly discovered would not be possible if we wanted to create a quality service for our users.
claims.narrative: werd niet haalbaar geacht met behoud van een kwalitatieve gebruikersdienst
claims.explanation: This accurately conveys the source’s assessment and its condition. “Moest blijven” is slightly less precise than the source’s “create,” but the narrative counterpart clarifies the intended meaning.
claims.materiality: A central constraint in the account; no material discrepancy.

claims.excerpt: De aanpak begon bij de ervaring van aanvragers: die werd eerst naar alpha gebracht.
claims.claim: The team focused first on the refund applicants’ experience and took that work to alpha.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment.
claims.narrative: De aanvragerservaring werd eerst naar alpha gebracht
claims.explanation: The order and alpha milestone match the source.
claims.materiality: Material description of the team’s sequence; accurately represented.

claims.excerpt: Het werk voor caseworkers kwam later.
claims.claim: Caseworker work came later than the work focused on applicants.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: Plans for the caseworker user came later.
claims.explanation: The source says plans for the caseworker user came later; the narrative uses that more precise wording. The source also says case-management development began during private beta.
claims.materiality: Material sequence detail; accurately represented at this level of generality.

claims.excerpt: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd vrijmaken voor testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.claim: During private beta, fortnightly sprints alternated between accepting applications and setting aside time for testing, research, and processing.
claims.label: F2 material incorrect, unsupported or misleading
claims.evidence: We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: Tijdens de private beta wisselden tweewekelijkse sprints af tussen aanvragen aannemen en tijd besteden aan testen, onderzoek en verwerking.
claims.explanation: The source describes each fortnightly sprint as split into two weeks: the first included accepting applications alongside testing and research; the second suspended submissions and focused on testing, research, and processing. The excerpt makes the activities sound like alternating, separate work periods and obscures that testing and research also occurred while applications were accepted.
claims.materiality: This changes the described work rhythm and the overlap between application intake and research/testing.

claims.excerpt: Zo combineerde het POA-refundteam een duidelijke volgorde — eerst aanvragers, daarna caseworkers — met gereserveerde tijd voor onderzoek en testen tijdens de beta.
claims.claim: The team’s approach combined an applicant-first, caseworkers-later sequence with time set aside for research and testing during beta.
claims.label: F0 faithful
claims.evidence: My team focused on the users applying for refunds first and this is what we took to the alpha assessment. Plans for the caseworker user came later. During private beta we started building the case management application while iterating the front-end, so we needed to create a solid research plan to stay focused on the different needs. We achieved this by splitting our fortnightly sprints in two: testing, researching and accepting applications in the first week and then suspending submissions to concentrate on testing, researching and processing applications the second.
claims.narrative: De beschreven aanpak combineerde een volgorde waarin aanvragers eerst kwamen met expliciet gereserveerde tijd voor onderzoek en testen.
claims.explanation: This summary combines two source-supported practices and does not state that they caused the launch or results. The separate description of the sprint rhythm is less precise, as noted above.
claims.materiality: The combined approach is the piece’s central takeaway and is supported, provided it is not read as a causal claim.
